title_tag: Symplectic Skeleton: Ten Variables Yield Standard Model Gauge Group
title_tag_alternates: How Ten Physical Laws Form a Symplectic Structure Matching the Standard Model

meta_description: Ten derived variables form five conjugate pairs via Darboux theorem, yielding Sp(10,R) whose subgroup chain recovers the Standard Model gauge group. Three independent roads converge at SU(5).
